The Kitchen

Cooked hot. Served honest.

Ember Kitchen runs on live fire and a short memory for shortcuts. No plating tweezers, no stock photography — every dish on this site came straight off our pass, camera in hand, steam still rising.

Loud flavor. Quiet ego.
